note: Seychelles: every visitor, whatever the nationality, must obtain an Electronic Travel Authorisation through the Seychelles Electronic Border System before departure (EUR 10 standard), and is then issued a free Visitor's Permit on arrival for 90 days (extendable, not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Seychelles
sources.said: All visitors to Seychelles are required to obtain an Electronic Travel Authorisation before departure. ... Citizens of all countries must obtain a free Visitor’s Permit on arrival after obtaining an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) through the Seychelles Electronic Border System prior to departure. The permitted stay for all nationals is 90 days.
